blocks.h2: Common Toilet Problems in McHenry Homes
blocks.intro: Most are fixed in one visit:

tiles.h3: It Runs or Refills on Its Own
tiles.body: Scale on the flapper or fill valve keeps them from sealing. Very common with hard water.
A failed wax ring or loose flange.
Iron and minerals from the water staining the bowl.
Scale has narrowed the rim holes or the jet at the bottom of the bowl.

blocks.intro: In McHenry, the water is behind a lot of toilet problems.

items.body: Minerals build on fill valves and flappers. When they stop sealing, the toilet runs and wastes water. New parts usually fix it.
Mineral buildup in the rim holes and siphon jet weakens the flush. Cleaning helps, and sometimes a new toilet is the better answer.
Orange or brown rings point to iron in the water. A [water test](/mchenry/water-filtration-systems) tells you if a filter makes sense.
If a basement toilet drains to an [ejector pump](/mchenry/ejector-pump), only toilet paper should go down it.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.preview: Scale or wear on the flapper or fill valve.
items.answer: Usually the flapper or fill valve isn't sealing, often because of mineral scale from hard water. Replacing them is a quick fix.

items.q: How do I get rid of orange stains in the toilet bowl?
items.preview: Use a cleaner made for iron and mineral stains. A filter stops them.
items.answer: A cleaner made for iron and mineral stains removes them. If they come back quickly, an iron filter or softener addresses the source.

items.q: Why is my toilet's flush weak?
items.preview: Scale in the rim holes or jet.
items.answer: Mineral scale can clog the small holes under the rim and the jet at the bottom of the bowl. Cleaning them can help. On an older toilet, replacement may be the better value.

items.q: Should I replace my old toilet?
items.preview: If it's cracked, clogs often or uses a lot of water.
items.answer: If it's cracked, clogs often or is an older high-water model, yes. Running and minor leaks are usually repairs.

items.q: How much does toilet installation cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the toilet and flange. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the toilet, whether the flange or shutoff needs replacing and removal of the old one. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
